title: IVG Savr 3000 Lemon Lime Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Lemon Lime IVG Savr 3000 Prefilled Pods offer a bold citrus pairing with crisp Lemon and sharp Lime for a bright, palate-cleansing vape. It’s a classic duo that delivers zingy flavour from first puff to last. Each refill includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a 4ml refill reservoir. Once assembled, the refill system automatically feeds the pod as you vape — no spills or refills required. Mesh coil technology provides smooth vapour and clean flavour with every draw. Designed for use with the IVG Savr 3000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to set up IVG Savr Prefilled Pod Step 1: Unpack the Device Remove the cap from the mouthpiece. Take out the silicone stopper from the pod. Step 2: Prepare the Refill Peel off the red sticker. Remove the rubber stop. Step 3: Connect the Pod Align the refill with the pod. Press until you hear a click. Step 4: Insert into Device Slide the full pod-and-refill unit into the Savr device. Step 5: Prime the Coil Wait a few minutes to let the coil fully saturate. ✅ Ready to Vape! Inhale to activate and enjoy.
